name: std::deque<T,Allocator>::rend, std::deque<T,Allocator>::crend
intro: Returns a reverse iterator to the element following the last element of the reversed deque. It corresponds to the element preceding the first element of the non-reversed deque. This element acts as a placeholder, attempting to access it results in undefined behavior.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Reverse iterator to the element following the last element.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: libc++ backports crend() to C++98 mode.
